title: Australian Risotto with Peas
description: A creamy and flavorful risotto dish from Australia, infused with sweetness and featuring garden-fresh peas.

ingredients.name: Vegetable Broth
ingredients.notes: low-sodium broth for a healthier option

ingredients.name: Sweetness (e.g., Onion, Shallot)
ingredients.notes: caramelized sweetness adds depth to the dish

ingredients.name: Fresh Peas
ingredients.notes: garden-fresh peas for added crunch and flavor

ingredients.name: Parmesan Cheese
ingredients.notes: grated cheese for a creamy finish

instructions: Heat the broth in a separate pot and keep warm.
In a large skillet, melt 1 tablespoon of butter over medium heat. Add the Arborio rice and cook, stirring constantly, for 1-2 minutes.
Add the white wine (if using) and cook, stirring constantly, until the liquid is almost completely absorbed.

Add 1 cup of warmed broth to the rice and cook, stirring constantly, until the liquid is mostly absorbed. Repeat this process, adding the broth in 1-cup increments, and waiting for it to be absorbed before adding more. This process should take about 20-25 minutes, or until the rice is cooked and creamy.

While the rice is cooking, melt the remaining 1 tablespoon of butter in a separate skillet over medium heat. Add the sweetness (e.g., onion or shallot) and cook, stirring occasionally, until caramelized and golden brown.
Add the peas to the skillet with the sweetness and cook, stirring occasionally, until the peas are tender.
When the rice is cooked, stir in the pea and sweetness mixture, followed by the Parmesan cheese.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
